nodes.name: One-step Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Certain amounts of metal salts (La(NO3)3·6H2O, (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O, and (CH3COO)2Co·4H2O), fumaric acid, and urea, were dispersed in Deionized water (DI water) in an autoclave, and the pretreated Ni foam was immersed into the solution. After 9 h reaction time at hydrothermal conditions, the self-supported Co-ALMO@NF electrocatalyst was obtained and directly used as an electrode.
